When it happened or was recorded
When someone in the file is already in the family, choose “Same person”: they are not added twice, and their family links from the file join them.

When the same person was recorded twice, merge the records: you choose which details to keep, and everything linked to either record — parents, children, partners, photos, stories, events and a claimed account — ends up on one person. The merge is recorded in the change history and can be undone.

When two verified lines of descent give different numbers — for example a marriage between cousins of different generations — the person is not numbered automatically. An administrator chooses the number, and the reason is recorded.
